operator_casefile.project_type: Steam Deck OLED internal SSD diagnosis, data-preserving replacement, and recovery workflow
functional_subsystems: Steam Deck OLED model and storage-interface identification
Existing SSD health and failure diagnosis
Chassis access, battery isolation, connector protection, and ESD control
Post-repair storage detection, boot, software, and data-restoration validation

decision_tree.action: Confirm the device is the OLED model using its physical model identifiers and board/chassis characteristics before using any guide or selecting storage.
decision_tree.purpose: Prevent applying an LCD-specific procedure or compatibility assumption.

decision_tree.action: If the current SSD is readable, inspect free space, SMART or equivalent health data, filesystem errors, boot behavior, and observed symptoms before purchasing a replacement.
decision_tree.purpose: Distinguish capacity shortage, software corruption, filesystem damage, and hardware failure; do not assume replacement will fix an unmeasured issue.

decision_tree.action: If the SSD is readable, create an external backup of required user data and verify that representative files can be opened from the backup.
decision_tree.purpose: Reduce data-loss risk; no preservation guarantee exists without a verified backup.

decision_tree.action: If the SSD is failing or unreadable, stop repeated write attempts and determine whether a professional data-recovery path is required before disassembly or reinstallation.
decision_tree.purpose: Avoid reducing recoverability through unnecessary writes or reinstallation.

decision_tree.action: Verify that the candidate replacement exactly matches the required Steam Deck OLED interface, M.2 2230 form factor, and single-sided physical envelope; reject any candidate lacking evidence for all requirements.
decision_tree.purpose: Avoid choosing a replacement based only on capacity or a generic M.2 label.

decision_tree.action: Proceed to disassembly only after backup or an explicit recovery decision, a suitable ESD-controlled workspace, the correct tools, and a recovery image or installation path are available.
decision_tree.purpose: Make physical work reversible and limit avoidable data and hardware risk.

decision_tree.action: After replacement, enter firmware or recovery tooling and confirm the new drive is detected before installing or restoring data.
decision_tree.purpose: Separate physical/interface problems from operating-system installation problems.

decision_tree.action: If detection, installation, boot, thermal behavior, or storage tests fail, stop at the corresponding gate and do not declare the replacement successful.
decision_tree.purpose: Prevent a success claim when the measured acceptance conditions are not met.

compatible_parts_or_requirements: Device-specific requirement: Steam Deck OLED must be confirmed before work; the supplied task explicitly prohibits substituting an LCD-specific guide without model review.
Storage requirement sourced from ifixit_deck_oled_ssd: Steam Deck OLED SSD is M.2 2230 and single-sided.

The replacement must also have an interface, keying, electrical characteristics, controller behavior, thermal envelope, and capacity supported by the Steam Deck OLED and intended operating-system workflow; exact compatibility is unverified from the supplied claims.
Use an appropriate external backup destination with enough capacity for the selected data; destination type and capacity are not supplied.
Use a SteamOS-compatible recovery or installation medium and a recovery image obtained from an authoritative source; exact image version and procedure are not supplied.
Use ESD-control equipment and suitable non-damaging disassembly tools. The supplied ifixit_deck_oled_ssd claim requires following ESD precautions.
Do not select a replacement SSD, enclosure, adapter, screw, thermal interface, or recovery medium as an exact part until compatibility and physical fit are verified.
Approximate cost categories, not sourced facts: replacement SSD, backup/recovery media, ESD and hand tools, and possible professional data recovery or repair labor.
build_or_repair_sequence: Record the current symptom, OS behavior, free space, SMART or equivalent health output, filesystem checks, and any error messages without assuming the SSD is the cause.
Confirm OLED identity and document the current SSD model, capacity, interface information, and visible physical configuration if safely accessible.
Back up required files and configuration data while the current drive remains readable; verify the backup by opening representative files and recording what was included.
Prepare the recovery/install path and document account, encryption, game-library, and application restoration requirements before removing the original drive.
Power down fully, disconnect external power, establish ESD controls, and follow a device-specific OLED disassembly procedure. Do not proceed if the procedure or tool fit is uncertain.
Access the SSD without stressing cables, shields, connectors, or the battery assembly; preserve the original SSD and hardware for diagnosis or recovery.
Install only a candidate that has independently verified M.2 2230 single-sided fit and Steam Deck OLED electrical/software compatibility. No exact replacement is authorized by the supplied evidence.
Reassemble with correct shielding, fasteners, connector seating, and no pinched cables, then perform a visual inspection before power-up.
Confirm drive detection in the available firmware or recovery environment.
Install or recover SteamOS using the selected authoritative recovery procedure, then restore backed-up data and reconfigure libraries or accounts as applicable.
Run the validation gates and record results; if any required gate fails, stop and diagnose rather than treating the SSD replacement as the solution.
critical_technical_unknowns: The current SSD health, SMART status, filesystem state, boot status, and exact failure symptoms are unknown.
Backup status, backup completeness, backup readability, and recovery objectives are unknown.
The exact Steam Deck OLED model identifier and hardware revision have not been independently documented.
The current SSD model and its interface details are unknown.
No exact replacement SSD has been proposed, so interface support, capacity support, firmware behavior, thermal behavior, endurance, and physical clearance remain unverified.
The required recovery-image version, installation method, encryption state, and restore procedure are unspecified.
The user's required data set, acceptable downtime, and tolerance for reinstallation or data loss are unspecified.
Disassembly tool availability, ESD controls, workspace conditions, and operator experience are unknown.
There is no supplied bench evidence, measured diagnostic output, or post-repair test result.

The supplied ifixit_deck_oled_ssd claims establish OLED M.2 2230 single-sided storage, additional recovery or installation work, and ESD precautions, but do not establish compatibility of any particular replacement part or that replacement will resolve the issue.
validation_plan: Identity gate: document evidence that the unit is OLED and confirm the chosen procedure is OLED-specific.
Pre-repair diagnosis gate: capture reproducible symptoms and storage-health or filesystem measurements; if measurements do not implicate the SSD, defer replacement.
Data gate: confirm required files exist in the backup and that representative files can be opened from the backup before removing the original SSD.

Compatibility gate: verify the candidate's exact form factor, single-sided construction, interface, physical clearance, and Steam Deck OLED support from reliable part documentation; reject unresolved items.
Assembly gate: after reassembly, inspect for connector seating, cable damage or pinching, missing fasteners, and abnormal physical conditions without powering an unsafe assembly.
Detection gate: confirm the replacement is detected by firmware or recovery tooling.
Installation gate: complete the selected recovery or installation workflow without unverified success assumptions.
Functional gate: verify normal boot, storage capacity reporting, filesystem access, sleep and resume, charging behavior, and representative application or game-library access.
Data-restoration gate: verify restored files and required user data against the pre-repair inventory.
Go/no-go rule: any failed identity, backup, compatibility, detection, installation, or functional gate blocks completion and requires diagnosis before further repair.
deliverable_gaps: No independent OLED model-identification procedure or device-specific identifiers are supplied.
No measured storage diagnostics, failure symptoms, SMART output, filesystem output, or error logs are supplied.
No backup inventory, backup destination, integrity result, or data-recovery decision is supplied.
No exact replacement SSD or evidence of interface, firmware, capacity, thermal, and physical compatibility is supplied.
No authoritative recovery-image reference, version, or step-by-step recovery procedure is supplied.
No detailed OLED disassembly sequence, tool list, fastener map, or connector-specific precautions are supplied beyond the sourced ESD requirement.
No acceptance measurements or post-repair results are supplied.
Cost information is limited to unsourced categories; no reliable prices, labor estimates, or data-recovery estimates are available.
